title: Diwali cake near Carlingford or Dundas? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Diwali is 8 November. Need a cake for the family near Carlingford, Dundas or Telopea that nobody has to check for egg?

Every cake at Num Nums is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the buttercream, not any of the 15 flavours. Rasmalai and Mango are two that suit a Diwali table.

Order with 48 hours' notice, which is what fresh to order actually takes. 6-inch from $39.99 serves 6-8. 10-inch from $74.99 serves 20-22. Pickup from Wigram Street, open till 10pm daily.

Order on WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati.
